name: Dual Claude — Pair Setup
description: Two panels side-by-side, each running its own Claude Code session. Use one for hands-on code edits and the other for planning / architecture / research. The two sessions don't share context — that's the point: each gets its own focused thread.

tabs.label: Claude — code
tabs.system_prompt_hint: This Claude session focuses on hands-on code edits. Be concrete: read files, propose diffs, run tests.

tabs.label: Claude — plan
tabs.system_prompt_hint: This Claude session focuses on planning + research. Don't write code unless asked — articulate options, surface tradeoffs, sequence work.

env_hints.purpose: Required in both sessions. Same key works for both.

notes: Pattern: split builder (code) + planner (plan). When you're stuck on the build, walk over to plan and articulate why.
Cost lookout: two sessions = ~2x token spend. Watch the live `total cost` indicator in the Pluto's Terminals header.
